description: Source code for an Odoo wizard module that generates third-party ledger reports with date and period filters.

classes.name: wizard_report
classes.description: Wizard interface class for generating third-party ledger reports with various filtering options.

methods.name: _get_defaults
methods.description: Sets default values for the report form, including fiscal year, company, and periods.

methods.name: _check
methods.description: Determines which report to generate based on the page_split option.

methods.name: _check_date
methods.description: Validates that the selected date range falls within a fiscal year.

methods.name: _check_state
methods.description: Validates the report state, date range, and checks for open invoice records.
